displayName: System Network Configuration Discovery: Internet Connection Discovery

tests.name: Check internet connection using ping Windows
tests.description: Check internet connection using ping on Windows. The default target of the ping is 8.8.8.8 (Google Public DNS).

tests.name: Check internet connection using ping freebsd, linux or macos
tests.description: Check internet connection using ping on Linux, MACOS. The default target of the ping is 8.8.8.8 (Google Public DNS).

tests.name: Check internet connection using Test-NetConnection in PowerShell (ICMP-Ping)
tests.description: Check internet connection using PowerShell's Test-NetConnection cmdlet and the ICMP/Ping protocol. The default target is 8.8.8.8 (Google Public DNS).

tests.name: Check internet connection using Test-NetConnection in PowerShell (TCP-HTTP)
tests.description: Check internet connection using PowerShell's Test-NetConnection cmdlet and the TCP protocol to check for outbound HTTP (Port 80) access. The default target is www.google.com.

tests.name: Check internet connection using Test-NetConnection in PowerShell (TCP-SMB)
tests.description: Check internet connection using PowerShell's Test-NetConnection cmdlet and the TCP protocol to check for outbound SMB (Port 445) access. The default target is 8.8.8.8.
